2. Core systems review and validation (network, world generation, entity, block, physics)
3. Content systems review and validation (terrain, player, inventory, crafting, combat, AI)
4. Utility systems review and validation (protocol, logging, performance, tools)
5. Terrain generation improvements (caves, rivers, lakes)
6. World map control architecture improvements (server/client)
7. Protobuf protocol usage and reference verification
8. Using statement existence audit and compile checks
9. Config file organization and data-driven approach validation
10. Dummy client for protocol testing improvements
11. Shared DLL architecture review and validation
12. Build/test/protobuf scripts execution
13. Documentation update and finalize with commit + push
